Stable

text.text:
Nailing down complex cases

Designed for internal compression with larger nail diameters designed to help prevent nail breakage.

standaloneimage_701977765.alt: T2 ICF fatigue and static charts

text.text:
Internal compression

Pre-loaded internal compression screw designed to provide up to 10mm of internal compression

 

Large nail diameters

8.0, 9.0, 10.0mm nail diameters designed to help prevent nail breakage

Compatible with cross screws

Nail designed to be compatible with cross screws to help prevent nail back-outs2

System instrumentation designed for an efficient and reproducible procedure with accurate nail insertion

Radiolucent instrumentation

Designed to provide clear visualization of implant position

Targeting device

Allows for insertion of nail and screws and designed for accuracy

pageshortdescription.shortDescTop: This nailing system is indicated for internal bone fixation of the foot for Neuropathic Osteoarthropathy (Charcot), fracture fixation, osteotomies, non-unions, mal-unions and fusions. The nail will be accompanied by instrumentation that was designed to promote accurate nail insertion.

1.bullet: Designed to allow up to 10mm of compression

2.bullet: Large nail diameters (8, 9, 10mm) designed to help prevent nail breakage

3.bullet: Type II anodized titatnium nail and endcap

4.bullet: Radiolucent instrumentation for clear visualization of implant positioning
